verse.verse_1: Ruin is for the defrauders. (Those who measure less.)
verse.verse_2: Those who when they take the measure from others, take it in full!
verse.verse_3: Whereas when they give others after measuring or weighing, they give them less!
verse.verse_4: What! Do they not expect that they will be raised?
verse.verse_5: (To be raised) for a Great Day?
verse.verse_6: The day when everyone will stand before the Lord Of The Creation.
verse.verse_7: Indeed, the record of the disbelievers is in the lowest place, the Sijjeen.
verse.verse_8: And what do you know, how (wretched) the Sijjeen is!
verse.verse_9: The record is a sealed text.
verse.verse_10: Ruin is for the deniers on that day!
verse.verse_11: Those who deny the Day of Justice.
verse.verse_12: And none will deny it, except every transgressor, rebel.
verse.verse_13: When you recite Our verses to him, he says, “Stories of earlier men!”
verse.verse_14: Not at all – but rather their earnings have heaped rust upon their hearts.
verse.verse_15: Yes indeed – they will be deprived of seeing their Lord on that day.
verse.verse_16: Then indeed they have to enter hell.
verse.verse_17: It will then be said, “This is what you used to deny.”
verse.verse_18: Indeed the record of the virtuous is in the highest place, the Illiyin.
verse.verse_19: And what do you know what the Illiyoon are!
verse.verse_20: The record is a sealed text.
verse.verse_21: Which is witnessed by the close ones.
verse.verse_22: Indeed the virtuous are in serenity.
verse.verse_24: You will recognise the freshness of serenity on their faces.
verse.verse_25: They will be given pure wine to drink, which is kept preserved, sealed.
verse.verse_26: Its seal is upon musk; and for this should those who crave be eager.
verse.verse_27: And it is mixed with Tasneem.
verse.verse_28: The spring from which drink the ones close to Allah.
verse.verse_29: Indeed the guilty used to laugh at the believers.
verse.verse_30: And when the believers used to pass by, they used to gesture at each other with their eyes.
verse.verse_31: And whilst returning to their homes, they used to return rejoicing.
verse.verse_32: And upon seeing the Muslims, they used to say, “Indeed they have gone astray.”
verse.verse_33: Whereas they have not at all been sent as guardians over them.
verse.verse_34: So this day it is the believers who laugh at the disbelievers.
verse.verse_36: Did not the disbelievers get repaid for what they used to do?
